We use micro-F1 score to evaluate all relation extraction tasks. ... We use F1score (F1), EM to measure QA task. ... Multiple choice tasks are measured by accuracy. ... In ESTER dataset, previous works also evaluate by HIT@1 ...

We use micro-F1 score to evaluate all relation extraction tasks. Since causal NLI only has two labels(entailment and contradiction), we evaluate them by binary-F1 score. We denote both micro-F1 and binary-F1 as F1. We use F1score (F1), EM to measure QA task. F1 measures the correctness of uni-grams in generated sentence comparing those in ground truth sentences. EM score measures the exactly matches of uni-grams. Multiple choice tasks are measured by accuracy.
